# dc-fl2: the text functions over surrogates and the 32,767-unit limit. E is U+1F600 (the pair
# D83D DE00, written _xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)); LEFT(E,1) and RIGHT(E,1) are read first, as the rows
# below use them to build a lone high or low surrogate.
LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)
RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)
MID(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1,1)
MID(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),2,1)
LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),2)
LEFT("a"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),2)
RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&"a",2)
MID("a"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&"b",2,1)
MID("a"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&"b",3,1)
LENB(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LENB(RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
_xlfn.UNICODE(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
_xlfn.UNICODE(RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
CODE(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)=RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)
EXACT(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
# LEN of text holding a lone surrogate: trailing, leading, in the middle, high or low.
LEN(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN(RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&"ab")
LEN("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&"b")
LEN(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512))
LEN(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN(RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN(RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN("a"&RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN(RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&"a")
LEN("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&"b"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LENB("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
# The slices over a trailing lone high surrogate.
LEFT("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),3)
LEFT("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),2)
LEFT("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),4)
RIGHT("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),1)
RIGHT("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),2)
MID("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),3,1)
MID("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),2,5)
LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),2)
RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),1)
RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512)&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),2)
LEFT("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&"b",2)
RIGHT("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&"b",2)
MID("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&"b",2,1)
# Other text functions over a lone surrogate.
UPPER("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LOWER("A"&RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
TRIM(" a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&" ")
CLEAN("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
SUBSTITUTE("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),"a","b")
REPLACE("ab"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),2,1,"x")
FIND(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),"a"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512))
FIND(RIGHT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),"a"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512))
SEARCH(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),"a"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512))
REPT(LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1),2)
_xlfn.CONCAT("a",LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
PROPER("a"&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)&"b")
# The 32,767-unit limit: REPT, & and CONCAT at and past it, with pairs at the edge.
LEN(REPT("a",32767))
REPT("a",32768)
LEN(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383))
REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16384)
LEN(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383)&"a")
LEN(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383)&"ab")
LENB(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383)&"ab")
LEN(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383)&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512))
LENB(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383)&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512))
RIGHT(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383)&_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1)
LEN(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383)&LEFT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),1))
LEN("a"&REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383))
RIGHT("a"&REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383),1)
LEN(_xlfn.CONCAT(REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383),"ab"))
LEN(_xlfn.CONCAT(REPT("a",32767),"b"))
LEN(_xlfn.TEXTJOIN("",TRUE,REPT(_xlfn.UNICHAR(128512),16383),"a"))
LEN(SUBSTITUTE(REPT("a",32767),"a","bb"))
LEN(CONCATENATE(REPT("a",32767),"b"))
LEN(REPLACE(REPT("a",32767),1,0,"b"))
